findings.title: Defer import calls until an app is requested
findings.body: Every import() expression in this object executes immediately when the app-store index is evaluated. Consequently, requesting a single calendar or payment provider still starts loading and evaluating all app packages, including unused providers; awaiting one property does not make the other imports lazy. This retains the all-app startup work the change is intended to avoid. Store loader functions (and optionally cache their promises) instead, and invoke only the selected loader.

findings.title: Await the asynchronous reschedule cleanup callbacks
findings.body: The new async callback is passed to forEach, which discards its returned promise. Errors from the newly asynchronous getCalendar call—including CalendarService constructor errors that previously reached the surrounding try/catch—now become unhandled rejections instead of being logged. The reschedule operation also proceeds without waiting for calendar initialization and deletion. Await Promise.all over mapped callbacks, or use an awaited loop inside the try block. The same conversion in wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts and the viewer bookings requestReschedule mutation needs the same treatment.
